item.dc:creator: Grease

item.dc:creator: RMK

item.title: 🪩 .links by greedfi

item.title: 📈 X Growth Manager by Mujjamel

item.title: 🏢 Account Research by Jacob Weaver
item.description: A research desk for one enterprise account: maps its buying committee from public sources, finds why-now triggers and cites a source for every claim. Drafts outreach for you to review and never sends on its own.
